scope: Brazilian public-data diagnostic and filename-family-disjoint adaptation evaluation, not verified physical-asset independence or UK validation
grouping: filename prefix before _DJI_, then first hyphen-separated token; a conservative proxy, not verified asset identity
sampling: fixed hash ordering, round-robin over coarse filename families, reject exact byte duplicates

prompts: crossarm of an electricity transmission tower
insulator string on an electricity transmission tower
earth wire peak at the top of an electricity transmission tower
long_multi.diagnostic_reference: reuse verified m1280 predictions from previous run; no duplicate inference

prompts: crossarm of an electricity transmission tower
earth wire peak at the top of an electricity transmission tower
insulator string on an electricity transmission tower

prompt_selection: highest pooled F1 at primary operating point on the original 100 diagnostic images; tie resolved by configuration order; all arms retained

overfit.selection: first eligible pure-glass and pure-polymer training images in frozen sample order; no dev or holdout images
overfit.augmentations: all geometric and colour augmentations disabled
overfit.claim: training-set implementation sanity only, not generalisation

adaptation.initialisation: fresh original pretrained weights, not the two-image overfit checkpoint
adaptation.selection: library best checkpoint by development-set fitness only; no early stopping, fixed 20 epochs

final_evaluation: original long prompt, diagnostic-selected prompt, and selected supervised checkpoint; score once on new heldout families after freezing selection
